title: Guardrails: add override-with-justification pathway (RBAC-restricted) + audit logging + rate limits
creator: Ethan Park
description:
## Context
Optimize config applies can change batching/caching/quantization/routing and have historically caused occasional quality regressions. Guardrails gating will block applies unless eval thresholds pass.

We still need a controlled escape hatch for true emergencies / business-critical rollouts: an **override with justification** pathway restricted to specific roles, fully audited, and rate limited to avoid normalizing bypass.

This ticket covers backend + policy plumbing for overrides (UI work is tracked separately).

## Requirements
### Functional
1) Add an override pathway on the Optimize apply flow when gating result is FAIL (and explicitly marked as overrideable).
2) Override requires:
   - RBAC permission check (restricted roles only).
   - Freeform justification (required; validated; stored).
   - (Optional) second-approver is NOT in scope for v1; keep design extensible.
3) Override must produce full audit logs:
   - who initiated override (actor), tenant/org, route/environment
   - config change summary + diff hash
   - gating inputs (model version, prompt set revision, suite IDs, threshold policy version)
   - gating outputs (failed metrics + deltas/CI, eval_run_id)
   - justification, override_reason code
   - enforcement mode (soft-block vs hard-block) and feature flag state
4) Rate limit overrides:
   - Per-tenant cap to prevent habitual bypass
   - Per-route or per-resource cap to prevent repeated overrides on a single workload
   - Return explicit error codes for rate limited vs unauthorized

### Non-functional
- Deterministic behavior: override should apply the exact proposed config delta that was evaluated.
- Audit payload must be PII-safe and adhere to audit event size limits.
- Override should be compatible with staged enforcement modes (observe-only → soft-block → hard-block).

## Proposed design
### API
- New endpoint (control plane): POST /v1/optimize/applies/{apply_id}:override
  - Body: { justification: string, reason_code: string }
  - Server validates:
    - apply_id exists and is in a blockable state (gating FAIL or TIMEOUT with overrideable=true)
    - user has permission optimize.guardrails.override
    - justification length 50–500 chars; must not be only whitespace
    - rate limit tokens available
  - On success:
    - marks apply record with override=true + justification
    - proceeds to apply config change as if gating passed
    - emits audit events (see below)

### RBAC
- Permission: optimize.guardrails.override
- Roles allowed (initial):
  - SRE Oncall (restricted internal role)
  - Platform Admin
  - Customer Org Admin (enterprise-only, behind feature flag)

### Rate limiting
- Token bucket in Redis:
  - Key 1: tenant:{tenant_id}:guardrails_override (max 5 / 24h)
  - Key 2: tenant:{tenant_id}:route:{route_id}:guardrails_override (max 1 / 1h)
- If limit exceeded:
  - HTTP 429 with error code OVERRIDE_RATE_LIMITED
  - include retry_after_seconds where possible

### Audit logging
- Emit two events:
  1) OptimizeConfigChange (existing) enriched with:
     - gating_outcome=FAIL
     - override_applied=true
     - override_justification
     - override_reason_code
     - eval_run_id, policy_version, prompt_set_revision
  2) OptimizeGuardrailsOverride (new event type) to make overrides easy to query in SIEM and dashboards.

Reference spec: sources/confluence/security-and-compliance/audit-logging/optimize-config-change-audit-events.json

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] Users without permission cannot override (403) and attempt is audited (authz_denied event field).
- [x] Justification required and validated; missing/too short returns 400 with explicit message.
- [x] Overrides are rate limited per tenant and per route (429).
- [x] Successful override applies the exact config delta that was evaluated; no re-generation of proposal.
- [x] Audit events include eval_run_id, policy_version, prompt_set_revision, and failed metric summary.
- [x] Metrics emitted: override_attempt_total, override_success_total, override_denied_total (labels: tenant_tier, reason).
- [x] Feature-flagged rollout (internal → pilot tenants → enterprise).

## Out of scope
- Two-person approval workflow / tickets-as-approvals.
- Customer-configurable rate limits.
- Overrides for model version changes outside Optimize apply.

## Links
- PM policy ticket: PM-844
- Enforcement plumbing: ENG-3913
- Audit events: ENG-3918
- Related: ENG-3917 (Console gating results panel), ENG-3919 (dashboards/alerts)
comments: 2025-01-17 (Ethan Park): Marking P0. We need this before we flip pilot tenants to soft-block; otherwise any false positives become a hard stop for CS/SRE.
2025-01-20 (Naomi Feldman): +1 on audit requirements. Please ensure override justification is mandatory and exported in audit logs. Also require redaction rules (no prompt text).
2025-01-22 (Sean Gallagher): Rate limiting is required for oncall. Suggest a per-tenant daily cap; we’ve seen ‘temporary’ bypasses become permanent. Also please log 429s so we can detect pressure.

2025-01-24 (Aditya Rao): Product note: UI copy should describe as “Request override” for customers; backend can keep endpoint name override. Ensure reason_code supports values like: INCIDENT_MITIGATION, BUSINESS_CRITICAL, FALSE_POSITIVE_SUSPECTED.

2025-01-28 (Benji Okafor): Implementing RBAC permission optimize.guardrails.override and wiring through apply service. Using Redis token bucket keys for tenant and route caps. Will emit separate OptimizeGuardrailsOverride event for easier reporting.

2025-02-03 (Marcus Lin): Security review: make sure justification is treated as audit data (immutable). Keep payload size bounded; avoid embedding full metric arrays—summary only + eval_run_id pointer.

2025-02-06 (Benji Okafor): PRs up; added integration tests for 403/429 paths. Hooked into existing OptimizeConfigChange audit event emitter and added new override event type. Feature flag guardrails_override_enabled defaults off.
2025-02-07 (Ethan Park): Merged and verified in staging. Next step: enable flag for internal tenant + 2 design partners in pilot (see ENG-3926 rollout plan).
